rows.text: when byte `02B40512` is non-zero, calls `003B5470` + 0x1C with 1 in `ecx` and then the call at `003B5470` + 0x25 with the incoming `edx` in `ecx` and that result in `edx`; then, independently, when byte `02B4050A` is non-zero, calls `003B5470` + 0x35 with 0 in `ecx` and then the call at `003B5470` + 0x3E with the incoming `ecx` in `ecx` and that result in `edx`; a zero byte skips only its own pair of calls
